# SYNESIS_E156 — Warning

## Description

2 registered IRI(s) outside NAMESPACE `https://example.org/id/`.

## Severity

This diagnostic is **local to an `EXPORT` block**. When compiling it is reported as a warning and the corpus still compiles; in `synesis export` it stops that block (that artifact is not written) and the other blocks run.

## Compiler message

```text
`EXPORT <FORMAT> <name>`: the REGISTRY has 2 published IRI(s) outside the current
  NAMESPACE `https://example.org/id/`; they are not checked and are absent from this file.

  The NAMESPACE is the researcher's decision. If the change is intended, links to the
  old IRIs will break: keep a redirect at the old address, or a separate REGISTRY.
```
